b: Home / Search Forum Recap / Daily Search Forum Recap: November 20, 2026
Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web.

Google is officially rolling out its new desktop search collapsible sidebar to promote AI search. Bing confirmed ads are showing in AI Mode. Bing has Made with AI labels on ads. ChatGPT tests a new card-like design. Google updated its sexual content policy again. A new TLD is coming for .seo. And I psoted the weekly SEO video recap.

Google Search Officially Rolls Out Collapsible Sidebar
Google is now officially rolling out what it calls the "collapsible sidebar" within Google Search. We spotted this a few weeks ago and we called it then the AI Mode sidebar in Google Search. Robby Stein from Google said "New on the Google desktop homepage globally: we're rolling out a collapsible sidebar to easily find & jump back into your recent AI searches."

Microsoft Confirms Ads Are In AI Overviews On Bing Search
Microsoft has just confirmed that it is now shows ads in AI Overviews in Bing Search. We started seeing ads in Bing AI Overviews about three weeks ago, and Microsoft has now confirmed this on the Microsoft Advertising blog.

Google, ChatGPT & Others AI Engines Provide Coupon Codes
Tis the season for holiday shopping and everyone wants to get a good deal, so you head over to your favorite search or AI engine and ask about coupon codes or promo codes available from that merchant. Google provides them in AI Overviews, ChatGPT provides them in its answers, so do the others - you don't have to go to the coupon websites to get them, you just copy them from the AI response.

Bing & Microsoft Ads - Made With AI Label
Microsoft is now showing a new label on some of its ads across Microsoft Advertising and Bing Search named "Made with AI." The label is appended to the image on the ad, at the corner of the image, and says "Made with AI."

ChatGPT Card Design
OpenAI may be testing a new card-like design in the ChatGPT interface that previews the different functionality available to users in ChatGPT.

Google Expands & Clarifies Sexual Content Advertising Policy Examples
Google has again updated its sexual content policy for Google Ads, like it did just last month. This time it added more detailed examples of both prohibited and permitted content across nudity, partial nudity, sexual merchandise, and sexual entertainment.

The .seo Top-Level Domain (TLD) May Be Coming Soon
A new top-level domain (TLD) or generic domain extension for .seo may be coming soon. It was applied for by XYZ under ICANN's new gTLD round and then confirmed on the final list following String Confirmation Day in October 2026. It is not yet generally available for standard public registration.
